nonmember_definition: held-out validation images from identities represented in training
timestep_policy: deterministic per image; same evaluation procedure for both groups
caveat: Exploratory attack; threshold accuracy is measured on the same sample used to choose the threshold.

final_interpretation.conclusion: The observed ROC-AUC is close to 0.5, indicating weak discrimination by this loss-based attack.
final_interpretation.limitation: The CSV split contains all 2000 identities in train, validation, and test. It does not establish exact diffusion training-image membership. The attack must therefore be treated as exploratory, not definitive evidence of privacy leakage.
final_interpretation.threshold_accuracy_caveat: The reported best threshold accuracy was selected and evaluated on the same samples, so it is descriptive rather than an independent estimate of attack accuracy.
